title: Longer reinforcement learning for the confirmed controllers, with a rate schedule
description: The confirmed controllers (experiments/controller-rl-confirm.json, release exp-controller-rl-confirm-31) at each teacher's setting continue by PPO for 240 more iterations, from the actor and value network each run left (init_from), now with a schedule for the actor's learning rate and the best policy kept. The same continuation without them (experiments/controller-rl-longer.json, cancelled) sent Cubic's runs to the smallest window: the first update after the restart was a large step from a fresh optimizer (up to 71% of decisions clipped), and at a rate of 0.0003 the policy drifted to where the reward's floor leaves no gradient back (width 16 seed 1 and width 7 seed 2 from -0.40 and -0.13 to -2.99); BBRv3's first finished run moved little (-0.23 to a best of -0.18 and back). Here the actor's rate ramps up over 5 iterations after the critic's 3-iteration warm-up and falls linearly to a tenth of its start by the last iteration: Cubic 0.0003 to 0.00003 (clip 0.2, noise 0.2), BBRv3 0.00003 to 0.000003 (clip 0.2, noise 0.1). Widths 7, 10 and 16 and the reference without an encoder, seeds 1 to 3: 24 runs. Everything else is as in the confirmation: 8 links with 4 rollouts each per iteration, 30 s episodes, noise held for 20 steps, reward horizon 1 s, no anchor, stopping at 4 h. Evaluation every 20 iterations on the 21 validation links under 6 conditions; each run keeps its best evaluated policy (policy-best.onnx, best.json) and scores as it (docs/methodology.md, comparing controllers). What is read: per teacher and width, the start (the confirmed score), the best and the last, and whether the schedule stops the collapse. The test links are not read.
run: case "$TEACHER" in cubic) LR=0.0003; END=0.00003; CLIP=0.2; NOISE=0.2;; bbr3) LR=0.00003; END=0.000003; CLIP=0.2; NOISE=0.1;; *) exit 2;; esac; R="ctl-$TEACHER-k$K-s$SEED"; T="$R-lr$LR-c$CLIP-n$NOISE"; S="$OUT/spec-$T.json"; jq --arg from "$IN/runs/$T" --argjson k "$K" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson lr "$LR" --argjson lrend "$END" --argjson clip "$CLIP" --argjson noise "$NOISE" '.algo = "ppo" | .init_from = $from | .inputs = "raw" | (if $k > 0 then .latents = $k | .action_max = 8 else . end) | .share_k = 0 | .critic_flows = true | .critic_warmup = 3 | .noise_sigma = $noise | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .tau_s = 1 | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .lr = $lr | .lr_warmup = 5 | .lr_end = $lrend | .clip = $clip | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .alone = 0.35 | .compete = 0.6 | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 240 | .eval_every = 20 | .time_budget_s = 14400' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/$T" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
collect: uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_report.py "$OUT" "$OUT"/ctl-*; uv run python experiments/settings_search.py "$OUT" "$OUT"/ctl-*; cat "$OUT/settings-search.md" "$OUT/summary.md" > "$OUT/both.md"; mv "$OUT/both.md" "$OUT/summary.md"
